tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted, Department will not supply any material
All the works are to be carried out as per the standard specifications issued from time to time by BIS & as per the relevant IS codes.

In the case of the death of a contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

The contractor along with his financial bid shall furnish a detailed rate analysis for such of the items where he has quoted lesser rates than the estimated rates. The rate analysis must indicate break up of rates for various components such as materials, labour, machinery and other relevant components. He shall also explain & substantiate how such lesser quoted rates would work out for him from the point of view of doing quality work. He shall also give undertaking that the rates quoted by me are workable to execute quality work as per specification and to the fullest satisfaction of the department Any failure on the part of the contractor in not fulfilling the above said information along with his Financial bid in e-proc is liable for rejection of his Financial Bid
GST Shall not be paid separately. Estimate rate is including GST
Tender will be evaluated as per circular no: IFA732/EXP-12/2023 Dtd:27.11.2023

The difference amount submitted by the contractor for the work will be released after successful completion of the work and receiving final bill and the 5% amount (Security deposit) will be released after completion of defect liability period

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Past Experience: MSME - Previous work orders and experience certificate should be uploaded for the similar supply and installation of Sanitary Incinerator with smoke control unit to the Government Departments 1 No OR for an amount of 4.00Lakhs (40%) in any ONE of the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) as per Section-XII. & MSMEs registration certificate should be uploaded. Non-MSMEs - Previous work orders and experience certificate should be uploaded for the similar supply of supply and installation of Sanitary Incinerator with smoke control unit to the Government Departments 1 No OR for an amount of 8.00Lakhs (80%) in any ONE of the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) as per Section-XII Authorized Suppliers - manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment and experience certificate should be uploaded for the similar supply of of supply and installation of Sanitary Incinerator with smoke control unit to the Government Departments 1 No OR for an amount of 3.00Lakhs (30%) in any ONE of the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) as per Section-XII and Manufacturer Authorization registration certificate should be uploaded.
The manufacturer should have ISO certificate ISO 9001 certificate

MSMEs -The Average Annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be not less than 5.00Lakhs (50%) in any one year during the last 3 financial years(2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) MSMEs registration certificate should be uploaded, OR Non-MSMEs and Authorized manufacturers-The Average Annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be not less than 10.00Lakhs in any one year during the last 3 financial years (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) CA certified turnover certificate with UDIN should be uploaded.
